results.content: On New Year’s Day, the Las Vegas Distillery Tasting Room will open at 1pm and host a Bloody Mary Bar! To complement the cocktails, Las Vegas Distillery will feature a few special kitchen offerings, including Las Vegas Distillery Bourbon-Candied Bacon, charcuterie sticks highlighting elements from the charcuterie board, and grilled cheese bites made with Monzu sourdough. **LAS VEGAS** (December 15, 2025) – Las Vegas Distillery proudly announces Vegas Valley and surrounding areas distribution, working with Copa Fina to make its artisan spirits available throughout Nevada. This milestone brings Las Vegas Distillery’s 100% locally produced premium spirits available to bars, restaurants, and retail outlets throughout the state, giving locals and visitors the opportunity to support small business in Nevada. Available every day from 4-7 p.m., The new Happy Hour includes six of TGT’s most popular tiki cocktails for $8 each, six favorite food items for $5-9, select beer for $5, and even Spiked Dole Whip for $8.\*
